target_buyers.why_target: Primary buyer for Permit Whisperer - municipal permit automation. City Manager is chief administrative officer with authority over all city departments including Planning & Community Development which handles zoning permits (first step in permit process).

contacts.name: James M. Timonere
contacts.title: City Manager
contacts.notes: Elected official (term: 12/1/2023 – 11/30/2027). Oversees all city departments except Solicitor, Finance, Municipal Court and Board of Health. Primary decision maker for city technology implementations.

target_buyers.why_target: Secondary contact for permit tool implementation - directly manages zoning permits which are required before building permits can be issued through the County.

contacts.name: Mary Church
contacts.title: Assistant Director, Planning & Community Development
contacts.notes: Manages Engineering, Housing, Fair Housing, Grants, Code Enforcement, and Zoning Departments. Zoning permits are required first before building permits go to County. Frequently presents to City Council on development matters.

additional_context.permit_process_note: City of Ashtabula contracts building permits to Ashtabula County Building Department in Jefferson, OH. Process: (1) Zoning permit from City Planning Dept → (2) Building permit from County Building Dept. Known contact: building@cityofashtabula.com | 440-992-7115.
